I farm here in Rukwa where the rains are good and maize grows well, so I put fertilizer on my maize plot — not too much because the price is high, maybe one bag of DAP at planting and some urea for top-dressing when the maize is knee-high. I also carry manure from my cattle to help the soil since I intercrop with beans. I stick with the seed I save from last season because the improved seed from town costs too much and I do not read the papers they give with it. My wife and I will do most of the work, but I will pay some young men from the village to help with weeding because 2.59 hectares is a lot of hoeing.
